roadmap.title: Opening — Gone Fishing to Chapter 4
roadmap.why: Play the story straight through; the chapters unlock everything else.

roadmap.title: Story missions — heists and jobs
roadmap.why: The mid-story set-pieces, cleared in order.

roadmap.title: Character finales — do not miss them
roadmap.why: Story-locked: finish every character strand before the finale.

roadmap.title: Partner moments — act early
roadmap.why: Act-early missables; do them while the windows are open.

roadmap.title: Activities — stunts, ranges, races
roadmap.why: Repeatable activities; grind them in free roam.

roadmap.title: Collectibles — map completion
roadmap.why: Sweep Leonida methodically; the map is the checklist.

roadmap.title: Free roam — crime and cash
roadmap.why: Robberies and combat trophies in the open world.

roadmap.title: Free roam — money and property
roadmap.why: Spend, launder and buy your way to the last few; 100% completion lands here.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — the platinum is the reward for finishing the whole list, so follow the roadmap stage by stage.

steps.text: Follow the 9-stage roadmap in order
Clear every story and missable trophy first
Sweep collectibles and activities in free roam
Earn the 54th trophy and the platinum follows

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from a fresh story — it is the game's first mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn.

steps.text: Start a new story game
Follow the opening prompts through Gone Fishing
Complete each objective as it appears
Reach the mission-complete screen
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1, in order — the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 1 missions in order
Clear each mission's objectives
Do not skip the chapter's final mission
Watch for the chapter summary screen

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2, in order — the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 missions in order
Clear each mission's objectives
Keep the story moving mission to mission
Watch for the chapter summary screen

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3, in order — the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 missions in order
Clear each mission's objectives
Bank the side content for later if you want
Watch for the chapter summary screen

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4, in order — the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 missions in order
Clear each mission's objectives
Save before the chapter's final mission
Watch for the chapter summary screen
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission — the gold trophy for seeing the ending through, whatever choice you make at the end.

steps.text: Reach the final mission in the story
Stock up on ammo and armour first
Complete every objective of the finale
Survive the final sequence to the credits

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission — a story mission, so it comes naturally if you keep playing the story in order.

steps.text: Advance the story until Breakfast Run appears
Take the mission when it is offered
Complete its objectives as prompted
Reach the mission-complete screen

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist — a story mission; keep playing the story in order and it arrives on its own.

steps.text: Advance the story until The Cartel Heist appears
Prepare a fast getaway vehicle first
Complete the heist's objectives as prompted
Reach the mission-complete screen

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission — a story mission, so it comes naturally if you keep playing the story in order.

steps.text: Advance the story until Child's Play appears
Take the mission when it is offered
Complete its objectives as prompted
Reach the mission-complete screen
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission — a story mission; keep playing the story in order and it arrives on its own.

steps.text: Advance the story until Headliners appears
Take the mission when it is offered
Complete its objectives as prompted
Reach the mission-complete screen

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission — a story mission set around the airport; it arrives as the story reaches VCIA.

steps.text: Advance the story until VCIA Takedown appears
Take the mission when it is offered
Complete its objectives as prompted
Reach the mission-complete screen

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory — a story mission; keep playing the story in order and it arrives on its own.

steps.text: Advance the story until Operation Savage Glory appears
Stock up on heavy weapons first
Complete its objectives as prompted
Reach the mission-complete screen

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the long haul: story, collectibles, activities and challenges all feed the percentage, so treat this checklist as the map and finish it last.

steps.text: Finish the story and every missable first
Clear the collectibles and activities stages
Mop up the remaining challenges and counts
Push the completion counter to 100%
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across free roam — jumps, near-misses and air time all count, so a fast car and a good ramp beat careful driving.

steps.text: Pick a fast car with good air control
Find jumps and ramps around Vice City
Land clean stunts and keep the chain going
Repeat until the counter hits 250

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — one try of all 9 types is enough, so sample everything the game offers instead of grinding one.

steps.text: Open the activities list in the game
Try one activity of a type you have not done
Move to a new type after each try
Cover all 9 types to pop the trophy

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — learn each range's pattern, keep a steady aim and use cover between waves.

steps.text: Visit a Shooting Range to learn the scoring
Practise one challenge until you gold it
Use cover and reload between waves
Gold all 42 challenges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — learn each course's shortcuts, then race it clean.

steps.text: Find a Top Fun drone race location
Fly the course once to learn its turns
Race it again and take the win
Repeat at all 14 locations
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — a win in each of 20 distinct race events counts once, so vary the vehicles and routes.

steps.text: Find a race event you have not won
Pick the right vehicle class for it
Win the race and move to a new event
Reach 20 distinct race wins

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — match his catch with better bait and timing, and do not rush the reel.

steps.text: Find Cal's fishing challenge
Pick bait that suits the spot
Keep the line tension in the green
Out-fish Cal to win the challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish any one arcade cabinet game end to end; pick the easiest cabinet and learn its loop.

steps.text: Find an arcade with working cabinets
Pick a game with a short loop
Learn its pattern over a couple of runs
Play it through to its end screen

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — his strand ends with this mission, so finish every Andy mission before the story moves past his arc.

steps.text: Take Andy's strand missions as they appear
Complete each one in order
Take his final mission when it is offered
Finish it before the finale locks it out
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide
trophies.missableNote: Andy's final mission closes once his strand ends — finish every Andy mission before the story moves past his arc.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — his strand ends with this mission, so finish every Kenton mission before the story moves past his arc.

steps.text: Take Kenton's strand missions as they appear
Complete each one in order
Take his final mission when it is offered
Finish it before the finale locks it out

trophies.missableNote: Kenton's final mission closes once his strand ends — finish every Kenton mission before the story moves past his arc.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — his strand ends with this mission, so finish every Billy mission before the story moves past his arc.

steps.text: Take Billy's strand missions as they appear
Complete each one in order
Take his final mission when it is offered
Finish it before the finale locks it out

trophies.missableNote: Billy's final mission closes once his strand ends — finish every Billy mission before the story moves past his arc.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — meet the strangers marked on the map and see each strand through; strands can close as the story advances, so do them as they appear.

steps.text: Watch the map for stranger markers
Take a strand and finish its missions
Move on to the next stranger
Complete 8 strands to pop the trophy

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide
trophies.missableNote: Stranger strands can close as the story advances — clear them as they appear instead of leaving all eight for the endgame.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — his strand ends with this mission, so finish every Randy mission before the story moves past his arc.

steps.text: Take Randy's strand missions as they appear
Complete each one in order
Take his final mission when it is offered
Finish it before the finale locks it out
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide
trophies.missableNote: Randy's final mission closes once his strand ends — finish every Randy mission before the story moves past his arc.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — his strand ends with this mission, so finish every Tyrone mission before the story moves past his arc.

steps.text: Take Tyrone's strand missions as they appear
Complete each one in order
Take his final mission when it is offered
Finish it before the finale locks it out

trophies.missableNote: Tyrone's final mission closes once his strand ends — finish every Tyrone mission before the story moves past his arc.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida — sit through each one and the count ticks per spot.

steps.text: Find a meditation spot on the map
Sit and meditate there until it registers
Move to the next unvisited spot
Cover all 18 spots to pop the trophy

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a one-time strand, so take the hunt when it appears and track the animal down.

steps.text: Meet Bret and take the hunt when offered
Follow the trail to the unique animal
Track it quietly and take the shot
Bring the hunt home for Bret

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide
trophies.missableNote: Bret's hunt is a one-time strand — take it when it appears or it may be gone.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — pick cards up as you explore Leonida and track each set's progress; three full sets is the goal.

steps.text: Pick up collectible cards as you explore
Check which sets are closest to complete
Hunt the missing cards of one set
Complete 3 full sets
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the WAiNK feature at 100 distinct spots; tag a location and move on.

steps.text: Open WAiNK at a new location
Tag it and confirm it registers
Move to a location you have not tagged
Reach 100 tagged locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — challenges accumulate across activities, so clear the easy ones first and let the count build.

steps.text: Open the challenges list in the game
Clear the shortest challenges first
Let harder ones complete as you play
Reach 50 completed challenges

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat — do it while partner missions are still available, and break line of sight.

steps.text: Bring your partner along for the run
Build the wanted level up to 4 stars
Break line of sight and switch vehicles
Stay hidden until the stars clear

trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner beside you and a 4-star wanted level — do it while partner missions are still available.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — an early-story window: three shops in a row, heat kept the whole way.

steps.text: Bring your partner along for the run
Rob the first shop and leave fast
Hit the second shop straight away
Rob the third without losing the heat
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner and three shops in a row — an early-story window; it cannot be done once your partner is gone.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — find and enter 100 distinct vehicles; the discovery log counts each new model once.

steps.text: Enter any vehicle you have not driven
Check the discovery log after each new one
Hunt rare models in traffic and parking lots
Reach 100 discovered vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — trigger it with five or more enemies grouped, then line the shots up.

steps.text: Find a spot with five enemies grouped
Trigger Combat Focus at the right moment
Down all five before the focus ends
One clean use is enough

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — VCIA access is story-gated, so leave the airport by an unscheduled route while you can still get in.

steps.text: Get into VCIA while access is open
Find a departure route off the schedule
Take a vehicle or plane out of the airport
Leave VCIA to pop the trophy

trophies.missableNote: VCIA access is story-gated — make the unscheduled departure while you can still get into the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — deal with a Rhino tank: steal one, survive one, or take one down, whichever the moment offers.

steps.text: Find a Rhino tank in the world
Get inside it or take it down
Survive the response it draws
Finish the encounter to pop the trophy
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — go in quiet, no alarms and no witnesses, and plan the exit before you enter.

steps.text: Scout the jewelry store first
Enter unseen and avoid the cameras
Take the goods without raising the alarm
Leave without being detected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — five vaults, five clean getaways; the count is per vault you escape with.

steps.text: Pick a bank and plan the entry
Crack the vault and grab the cash
Escape the police response cleanly
Repeat for 5 vaults

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape — stop a truck, crack it open, and vanish before backup arrives.

steps.text: Find an armored truck on its route
Stop it without wrecking the cargo
Take the cash from inside
Escape before backup arrives

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every one of the 52 named areas; the map fills in as you go, so grey areas are your checklist.

steps.text: Drive the coast road and the highways
Check the map for areas still grey
Visit each grey area in turn
Cover all 52 areas to pop the trophy
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — nine gangs, one operation each; learn each gang's turf and hit it.

steps.text: Find a gang's illegal operation
Rob it and escape cleanly
Move to the next gang's turf
Hit all nine gangs to pop the trophy

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a quiet early-story moment; take it before the plot moves on.

steps.text: Go to Ocean Beach early in the story
Find the cocktail spot with the view
Order the cocktail
Stay for the view to pop the trophy

trophies.missableNote: A quiet early-story moment on Ocean Beach — take it before the plot moves on.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive in, build speed, and leave through the front glass.

steps.text: Enter a vehicle showroom in a car
Build speed on the showroom floor
Smash out through the front
Leave the showroom to pop the trophy

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — play a full game there; a complete game is what counts.

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Start a full game
Bowl every frame to the end
Finish the game to pop the trophy
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a partner beat tied to the early story; play the partner strand and do not rush past it.

steps.text: Play the partner strand as it opens
Hit the mass-appeal beat when it comes
Complete the scene with your partner
Finish the beat to pop the trophy

trophies.missableNote: A partner beat tied to the early story — do not rush past it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PSN tracks 500 choices, so keep choosing: dialogue options and mission choices all count.

steps.text: Make choices in missions as they come
Pick dialogue options instead of skipping
Keep a running count in the tracker
Reach 500 choices to pop the trophy

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — fail something once, then succeed on the second try; a one-time beat that cannot be replayed.

steps.text: Attempt the beat and fail it once
Try again immediately
Succeed on the second attempt
The second success pops the trophy

trophies.missableNote: Fail once, then succeed on the second try — a one-time beat that cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a strange one-off event; be in the right place at the right time, early.

steps.text: Watch for the strange event in free roam
Trigger it when it appears
See the event through to its end
The event pops the trophy
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide
trophies.missableNote: A strange one-off event — be in the right place at the right time, early.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone flat from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon, like a bowling pin.

steps.text: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Drive past a target at speed
Swing the melee weapon from the vehicle
Knock the target down to pop the trophy

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — move marked bills through contacts in batches until the total is reached.

steps.text: Collect Marked Bills from jobs
Find a contact who launders them
Launder a batch and bank the clean cash
Reach $250,000 laundered

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and cars all count toward the total spend.

steps.text: Shop as you play instead of hoarding cash
Track the total spend in the tracker
Buy big-ticket items when you can
Reach $100,000 spent

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — eight garages for sale across Leonida; buy them all.

steps.text: Find a garage property for sale
Buy it and check it off
Find the next garage for sale
Own all 8 garages to pop the trophy
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — register ten vehicles you own or find, straight from the app.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app
Register a vehicle you own or find
Check the registration count
Register 10 vehicles to pop the trophy
